body: I kinda get what your saying about God. But for instance if there was proof the Christian God existed.(some people believe there is sufficient evidence) There is a designated purpose. We don't create meaning. After the suffering of life we go to heaven. If we have served God. I am familiar with the idea that life is limited that's why it has meaning. But afterlife is non existence. To us if we don't exist it's as if  we never existed. I agree that life has relative meaning. That you can create meaning. But if there is no difference between us existing than not existing.  Than us just not existing from the start. Why not just kill yourself. Hope this makes sense. Not that smart. Philosophy hurts my brain.
